note: Stopped after 62 minutes on ML-100K (100k interactions, 20 epochs, one BLAS thread) running the shipped dense+cached propagation. Under identical conditions LightGCN finishes the same data in 151s and NCF in 162s. An earlier attempt on a laptop was killed at 41 minutes. Recorded as a non-completion rather than omitted from the table: a model that cannot finish the smallest standard benchmark within an hour is itself a result. When it has finished under looser conditions it scored NDCG@10 0.334, below implicit's ItemKNN at 0.386, which trains in 0.08s.
